extractions.label: player_alchemy_max_hp
extractions.expression: (() => { const script = idleon.allScripts.ActorEvents_12; const original = script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax; let calls = 0; let maximumHP; try { script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax = function(...args) { calls++; maximumHP = original.apply(this, args); return maximumHP; }; idleon.callFunction('TalentCalc', -2); } finally { script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax = original; } if (calls !== 1 || script._customBlock_PlayerHPmax !== original) throw new Error('Alchemy HP capture must intercept exactly one call and restore PlayerHPmax'); return maximumHP; })()
extractions.description: Normal HP actually sampled by MinEff inside target TalentCalc(-2); restore recorder in finally
